mapper.select: SELECT * FROM content_event_outbox WHERE dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM content_event_outbox WHERE dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM content_event_outbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM content_event_outbox WHERE AND attempts < 20 AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now})) ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, created_at ASC, event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE content_event_outbox SET status = 'SENDING', attempts = attempts + 1, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND AND attempts < 20 AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now}))

UPDATE content_event_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = #{now}, last_error = 'LEASE_EXPIRED_AFTER_MAX_ATTEMPTS' WHERE AND status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now} AND attempts >= 20 ORDER BY lease_until ASC, event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE content_event_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = #{now}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND AND status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, event_type FROM content_event_outbox WHERE event_type NOT IN ( 'SOLUTION_PUBLISHED', 'SOLUTION_LIKED', 'SOLUTION_COMMENTED', 'COMMENT_REPLIED', 'COMMENT_LIKED', 'SOLUTION_MODERATED', 'COMMENT_MODERATED' ) AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now})) ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, created_at ASC, event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
